0.x: Society was stratified in the order **Brahmana, Kshatriya, Vaishya, Shudra** = the **Varna system** (varna came to rest on **birth**; the spread of jatis is post-Vedic).

r: Farmers, herders, traders, artisans; the only tribute-payers
Service; no upanayana, no Vedas, no Sabha

The upper three varnas, entitled to upanayana
Shudra = "**servant of another**", who could be expelled or beaten at will

0.x: The **Chhandogya Upanishad** names the **Chandala** as a person of despised birth – an early sign only; untouchability was absent in the Rigvedic age.
Untouchability took **clear, formal shape in the Dharmashastra phase** (early Christian era), not in the Rigvedic or Later Vedic phase.
**Sarthavaha** (caravan leader, head of a trade guild / Srenipramukh) = a **Vaishya**; guild rules = **Samay, Srenidharma**; Vaishya guilds (gana) were headed by a **Shreshthin**.
The first reference to **money-lending** is in the **Shatapatha Brahmana**; usurer = **kusidin**.

1.x: The **four ashramas** are a custom that **emerged in the post-Vedic (Later Vedic) period**; the varnas go back to the Rigveda's Purusha Sukta, and Indra, Surya, Rudra and the Maruts are Rigvedic gods.
Only the first three were established in Later Vedic times: the first three appear in the **Chhandogya Upanishad**; all four first in the **Jabala Upanishad**.
**Purusharthas:** Dharma (duty), Artha (wealth), Kama (desire) = the **trivarga**; **Moksha** (liberation) was added later under Upanishadic ideas.

2.x: **Gotra** literally = **cow-pen** (the word first occurs in the **Rigveda**, meaning a cow shelter); as a **clan descended from a common male ancestor** it was established in **Later Vedic (post-Vedic) times**; the Atharvaveda mentions gotra in the lineage sense.
**Gotra exogamy:** no marriage within the same gotra (with caste endogamy and **sapinda** rules).
**Irawati Karve:** *Kinship Organization in India* (1953) – four kinship zones.

3.x: **Samskaras = 16** (shodasha): 3 before birth (Garbhadhana, Pumsavana, Simantonnayana), Jatakarma, Chudakarma (tonsure, 3rd year) … Upanayana, Vivaha, Antyeshti.

**Upanayana** = the sacred-thread initiation into Vedic study for the **upper three varnas**, in the boy's **8th year**; fully described in the **Shatapatha Brahmana**; **Shudras and women excluded**.

r: Initiated the pupil; taught the whole Veda free
